museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave3.name: Endless Museum — Infrastructure and Dynamic Bounds
museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave3.truth: The museum's supports, warnings, and sightlines are spatial arguments too.
museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave3.qfep_connection: Static bodies, institutional functions, and dynamic effects negotiate different kinds of spatial extent through one visible contract layer.
museum_aaa_test_cohort_wave3.description: Ten candidates test safety props, surveillance, museum furniture, working tables, one-sided surfaces, and particle-field bounds.
learning_objectives: Distinguish artifact space from museum-infrastructure space
Read sightline, reach, service, and behavioral envelopes as different contracts
Recognize when mesh measurement cannot represent dynamic extent
Verify framed assembly and an enforced particle-field envelope
content: Museum_AAA_Test_Cohort_Wave3: ten candidates, ten visual passes, zero open reviews
